definitionZh: 形状递归的CSS属性为渲染器提供了在渲染形状如路径,圆圈,或矩形时如何权衡的提示. 它只会对,,,,,,和元素产生影响. 如果明确声明,CSS属性的值将超过元素属性的任何值.
sourceDefinition: The shape-rendering CSS property provides hints to the renderer about what tradeoffs to make when rendering shapes like paths, circles, or rectangles. It only has an effect on the , , , , , , and elements. If explicitly declared, the value of the CSS property overrides the any values of the element's attribute.
